newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: New shares in SEZ priced at 960 Sfr.
newsitem.headline: New shares in SEZ priced at 960 Sfr.

text.p: New shares in SEZ Holding AG, a Swiss holding company for Austria's SEZ Semiconductor-Equipment Zubehoer fuer die Halbleiterfertigung AG will be priced at 960 Swiss francs a piece.

The subscription period for the new shares runs from November 13 to November 18. The initial public offering (IPO) comprises 113,890 registered A shares, each with a nominal value of 50 francs, SEZ said in a statement.
